title: Upgrade bd 1.1.0 to 1.3.0 across all beads repos
description: Shared bd binary (~/.local/bin/bd, 1.1.0 embedded) serves 9 clones / 6 databases: bodha x3 clones, coding-ritual+dws, equity-os, orchestrators, via, vip-agent. 1.3.0 runs schema migrations 53->66 plus a clone-local series; after install, unmigrated DBs are gated and dolt push/pull blocked. Procedure per https://beads.gascity.com/getting-started/upgrading: (1) rehearse migrate on scratch copies with a scratch 1.3.0 binary; (2) owner pauses running agents; (3) with 1.1.0: dolt pull+push and bd export --all backup per clone, record bd stats baseline, keep bd-1.1.0 for rollback; (4) install 1.3.0; (5) migrate one designated clone per database and dolt push; (6) bd bootstrap the other clones; (7) hooks install, stats vs baseline, doctor, export. Moved from via-sdj.1.
acceptance_criteria: bd version 1.3.0; every clone opens and bd stats matches its pre-upgrade baseline; bd doctor clean or pre-existing only; hooks reinstalled; pre-upgrade JSONL backups kept per clone.
notes: Owner approved dolt push/pull for the upgrade? Not yet: ask before step 3.

title: Cross-project beads dashboard
description: Local dashboard tracking all beads-backed projects. Page 1: cross-project overview (bd counts open/in_progress/blocked/deferred/closed, active agent work, last ~12 done, needs-you questions/blockers, next pending). Page 2: beads explorer (epic>task>subtask tree, status filters, closed children shown with green check, rollup e.g. open 5/7 beside the stored status, side detail panel per item). Projects registered by folder path in gitignored local config. Beads is sole authority for counts/status; a fixed-format per-task progress file carries narrative + open questions, parsed deterministically (Haiku scraper only as fallback). Read-only over beads. Moved from via-sdj.
notes: Open questions: project list; read-only vs answering bd human from UI; '12 lines' meaning (summary length vs recent-task count); live refresh vs on-load. Precondition: bd upgrade (child task).
